unresolved_findings.detail: The downside survives by assuming investment deferral that the evidence does not establish. In year 1, low planned organic deployment is USD 87.31427 billion, but the graph funds only USD 9.9034359 billion, automatically eliminating USD 77.4108341 billion. doc_bfd95d29529bb76a reports fiscal 2027 purchase commitments of USD 169.008 billion, including open orders and take-or-pay contracts, plus construction commitments of USD 29.848 billion. These amounts overlap operating and investment budgets and must not simply be added. Nevertheless, the contract supplies no reconciliation establishing which payments can actually disappear. Separate mandatory payments from deferrable deployment, reconcile overlaps, and execute a joint operating shock with constrained cancellation and unavailable financing. If resources then fail before payment deadlines, implement the required senior waterfall and cessation of common payouts.

Infrastructure lease expansion is acknowledged without a measurable cash allocation. doc_d5b8803c90cbff21 Note 12 reports USD 70.973 billion of commenced finance lease liabilities, USD 5.192 billion of quarterly finance lease additions, and USD 364.6 billion of additional uncommenced leases beginning through fiscal 2034. The graph pays principal estimated from existing maturity rows and constant annualized September interest; continuation then retains the fiscal 2028 principal allowance. Cash PPE budgets do not themselves discharge future leased-capacity obligations. Estimate and stress commencement timing, operating versus finance lease cash, interest, principal and replacement, explicitly identifying what margins, conversion and investment already include. Exact future allocations require judgments, not an impossible request for reported forecasts.

The operating_cash_conversion justification compares projected normalized earnings with a historical GAAP denominator. Fiscal 2026 OCF of USD 182.935 billion divided by adjusted earnings of USD 128.786 billion is approximately 1.420, whereas the cited approximately 1.37 uses GAAP income containing investment effects. The historical bridge is arithmetically correct, but USD 14.189 billion of deferred-tax addbacks and operating-balance movements are not independently recurring owner earnings. Base fiscal 2028 conversion adds approximately USD 61.727 billion to normalized earnings before separate deductions. Reconcile that forecast difference into depreciation, SBC, cash taxes and working capital, then establish sustainable continuation cash conversion without preserving temporary tax or funding benefits indefinitely.

The continuation transition is insufficiently tied to deployment economics. Base year 2 spends USD 108.517468 billion on organic growth plus acquisitions, while terminal owner cash of approximately USD 157.807588 billion is projected using independently selected growth and incremental-return assumptions. The stated historical approximately 17% diagnostic uses incremental adjusted accounting earnings over contemporaneous gross deployment, not incremental owner cash over incremental equity capital after maintenance and financing. Its acknowledged limitations do not establish the selected 13% return or investment lag. Reconcile explicit deployment to subsequent incremental earnings and cash, including leased capacity and supplier capital, and test delayed or unsuccessful commissioning with committed costs remaining payable.
